name: Big Tent Single Release + Aluminimum
description:
Big Tent is releasing our debut single and you're invited to celebrate with us at Mir in Grünerløkka for our first live show, which will also feature a set by Aluminimum!

Big Tent is a new punk band based in Oslo playing a high-energy blend of pop-punk and emo, with guitarist/vocalist Joe Rollwagen and bassist Max Krafft joined by Mats Mathiassen on drums. Recommended for fans of Knuckle Puck, Koyo, The Story So Far, No Pressure, Green Day, and The Offspring.

Aluminimum plays happy and melodic punk rock, mostly in Norwegian and a little in English. They write most of the songs themselves, but also include some by other people. Their songs are about life's small and big mysteries, which everyone can identify with. Aluminimum is Arne Frisch (guitar and vocals), Lars Fosshaugen (guitar), Juan Gomez (bass), and Ola Garthe (drums).
